rationale: Aryan's full-stack development expertise complements Hristina's product management background and vision for AI-driven healthcare solutions. Together they could explore building human-centered AI tools that improve research workflows, with Aryan handling the technical implementation using his full-stack skills while Hristina shapes the product strategy around her conviction that AI should support processes like grief processing in healthcare.
intro_message: Aryan Suri, meet Hristina Milojevic, PhD — a product manager focused on AI tools for healthcare research who could benefit from your full-stack development experience to help bring her vision of human-centered AI workflows to life.
